title: The Taxi Driver
prompt: A lady is lucky enough to find a free taxi. But during the ride she turns out to be so talkative that the driver is about to lose his patience, so he tells her: "I'm very sorry, madam, but I can't hear a word you're saying. I'm stone deaf and my hearing aid is broken." On hearing this, the passenger stops talking. As soon as she gets out of the taxi she realizes the driver was not telling the truth. How did she realize?
solution: She realized the driver couldn't be deaf, because he had taken her to the exact address she had given him.
